items.label: 【90% Pre-Assembled Easy to Install】
items.value: Still struggling with complex installation processes and unclear instructions? Try this 90% pre-installed dog cage! Most of the parts have already been pre-installed, you only need to focus on 4 large frames. New Puppy parents can set it up in minutes with simple installation and step-by-step instructions.

items.label: 【Cleaning by Sweeping Robot】
items.value: With 3.94 inch raised feet, the dog crate furniture allows sweeping robots to enter and clean. Easily maintain cleanliness and tidiness, no need to struggle with moving dog cage during general cleaning. Keeping the bottom of the dog cage dry and clean can make dogs away from dust and moisture, preventing health hazards.

items.label: 【Every Dog Has Their Own Door】
items.value: Both front and 2 side doors of the wood dog crate can be opened. When two dogs are impulsive or unfamiliar with each other, they can pass through their own side doors separately to avoid hyper activity. When they become familiar, the spacious front door will give them more freedom and convenience.

items.label: 【Provide Ample Space for Dogs】
items.value: With 78.74" W x 27.56" D x 32.68" H dimension, the dog kennel furniture allows dogs to stand freely and turn around easily in the crate. Dogs will have a comfortable and spacious living space, avoiding anxiety and unease due to limited space. The middle partition can be installed or removed according to your needs, the specific installation steps can refer to the detailed manual.

items.label: 【Sturdy and Chew-Resistant】
items.value: The data won't lie, all materials have been upgraded and thickened. In order to make the dog cage more sturdy, it uses 0.5 inches of thickened metal pipes and wooden boards, and a load-bearing metal tube has been added at the bottom. Thicker wooden boards and metal pipes are more sturdy, bite resistant, and have better load-bearing capacity.

items.label: 【Versatile Dog Crate Table】
items.value: Brief and retro dog furniture crate is suitable for various decoration styles. It is not only a dog crate for dogs, but also a TV cabinet/side table to place decorations and storage. The huge size ensures dogs have a comfortable and spacious living area, while also maximizing the use of the house's space.

items.label: 【Comprehensive After-Sale Services】
items.value: We prioritize pet’s safety and comfort inside the crate, the product’s durability and long-term use, and a better customer service experience for you. You can easily obtain satisfactory after-sale services since we have been here all along!
